column5: resolves one PARAM element (state binding, env or local parameter) to a vec4: switch on the element kind written by arbfpParseParameterBinding (5..9 material, 0xa..0x10 light, 0x11/0x12 light model, 0x13..0x15 light products, 0x16 fog color, 0x17 fog params, 0x18 depth range, 0x19 texenv color, 0x1a..0x31 matrix rows incl. inverse/transpose, 0x32 env, 0x33 local)
makes program slot param_2 current: stores it, fetches the program object from the slot table and re-evaluates the context state
sets per-texture-unit usage bits and fragment/texture dirty bits in the context from the bound program's flags
zeroes a 0x78-byte program object and allocates its instance table (+0x70) and a 0x98-byte compiled-program record (+0x74)
releases every instance, the instance table, the compiled program's code buffer (+0x60), unit table (+0x94) and the record itself

loads program text into the current fragment program slot: text starting '!!ILfs1.0' is kept as IL, anything else is compiled by arbfpCompileProgram; GL_INVALID_OPERATION (0x502) on a parse error, 0x505 on allocation failure
wraps raw IL words in a '!!ILfs1.0\n' header and loads them through arbfpProgramString
allocates the two default fragment program objects (current and default slots) with target 0x8804 (GL_FRAGMENT_PROGRAM_ARB)
allocates a new instance table, copies the old entries and frees the old table
compiles the minimal program '!!ARBfp1.0\nEND\n' into the current slot and binds it
